# Preference: Note-Taking Tool

## Statement

Alex uses Obsidian as the primary note-taking and knowledge management application.

## Context

Obsidian stores notes as plain markdown files on disk, which Alex prefers over cloud-only tools.
The vault is synced via a local folder and backed up to a private repository.
Plugins used include Daily Notes, Templater, and Dataview for querying notes.
Obsidian pairs well with the cognitive-ledger project for structured personal knowledge.
